answer: A Sybil defense that works is earned reputation that cannot be bought or cloned overnight. Each agent starts at dawn with zero standing and must complete small, peer-attested jobs to build trust, like laying copper wire one strand at a time. A juniper cutting planted today is not a tree tomorrow; likewise, a fresh identity cannot instantly transact at scale. An attacker spinning up thousands of fakes faces the same grind per identity: real work, real time, real attestation, which makes mass fakery expensive and slow while honest agents accumulate standing.
